crossRefs.note: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will…
Shall it be said, O house of Jacob: “Is Yahweh’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who…
He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken…
It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has…
If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from…
Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him, and he can’t know…
But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…

translations.web: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
translations.bsb: They are all plain to the discerning, and upright to those who find knowledge.
translations.kjv: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
translations.asv: They are all plain to him that understandeth, And right to them that find knowledge.
